mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT acp.id AS id, acp.ar_view_id AS "arViewId", acp.channel_code AS "channelCode", acp.cruise_plan_number AS "cruisePlanNumber", acp.cruise_plan_name AS "cruisePlanName", acp.execution_status AS "executionStatus", acp.execution_step AS "executionStep", acp.delete_flag AS "deleteFlag", acp.create_time AS "createTime", acp.update_time AS "updateTime", acp.creator AS creator, acp.modifier AS modifier, sti.tenant_name AS "tenantName", acp.tenant_id AS "tenantId" FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan acp left join sys_tenant_info sti on sti.tenant_id = acp.tenant_id WHERE acp.delete_flag = 0 AND acp.ar_view_id = #{param.arViewId} AND acp.channel_code = #{param.channelCode} AND acp.cruise_plan_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.cruisePlanName},'%') AND acp.execution_status = #{param.executionStatus} AND acp.create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(#{param.queryTime}, ' 00:00:00') AND CONCAT(#{param.queryTime}, ' 23:59:59') order by acp.create_time desc

WITH t1 AS (SELECT id, ar_view_id, channel_code, execution_status FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND ar_view_id = #{arViewId} AND channel_code = #{channelCode} AND execution_status = 1) SELECT t1.id, t1.ar_view_id, t1.execution_status, t2.id AS "executionStep", t2.stay_duration, t2.order_num, t3.coordinate, t3.resolutionx AS "resolutionX", t3.resolutiony AS "resolutionY", t1.channel_code, t2.tag_id, t3.preset_id AS "presetId", t2.tag_class, t2.id AS "arCruisePlanRelId", t3.longitude, t3.latitude FROM t1 LEFT JOIN vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel t2 ON t1.id = t2.cruise_plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_ar_tags_info t3 ON t2.tag_id = t3.id WHERE t2.delete_flag = 0 AND (t3.delete_flag = 0 OR t3.delete_flag IS NULL) AND t2.order_num = IF( (SELECT MAX(order_num) FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel WHERE cruise_plan_id = t1.id and delete_flag = 0) < #{orderNum}, 1, #{orderNum})

SELECT t1.id, t1.ar_view_id AS "arViewId", t1.channel_code AS "channelCode", t1.cruise_plan_number AS "cruisePlanNumber", t1.cruise_plan_name AS "cruisePlanName", t1.execution_status AS "executionStatus", t1.execution_step AS "executionStep", t2.tag_id AS "tagId", t2.is_open AS "isOpen", t2.order_num AS "orderNum", t2.stay_duration AS "stayDuration", t3.tags_type AS "tagsType", t3.tags_position AS "tagsPosition", t3.tags_name AS "tagsName", t3.tags_desc AS "tagsDesc", t3.coordinate, t3.resolutionx AS "resolutionX", t3.resolutiony AS "resolutionY", t3.preset_id AS "presetId", t1.tenant_id AS "tenantId", t1.industry_code AS "industryCode", t2.tag_class FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan t1 left join vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel t2 ON t1.execution_step = t2.id left join vm_ar_tags_info t3 ON t2.tag_id = t3.id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND (t3.delete_flag = 0 OR t3.delete_flag IS NULL) AND t1.ar_view_id = #{arViewId} AND t1.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND t1.execution_status = 1
SELECT t2.id FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan t1 left join vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel t2 ON t1.id = t2.cruise_plan_id where t1.delete_flag = 0 and t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.id = #{id} ORDER BY order_num limit 1

SELECT t1.id, t1.ar_view_id AS "arViewId", t3.channel_code AS "channelCode", t1.cruise_plan_number AS "cruisePlanNumber", t1.cruise_plan_name AS "cruisePlanName", t1.execution_status AS "executionStatus", t1.execution_step AS "executionStep", t3.id AS "tagId", t2.is_open AS "isOpen", t2.order_num AS "orderNum", t2.stay_duration AS "stayDuration", t3.tags_type AS "tagsType", t3.tags_position AS "tagsPosition", t3.tags_name AS "tagsName", t3.tags_desc AS "tagsDesc", t3.coordinate, t3.resolutionx AS "resolutionX", t3.resolutiony AS "resolutionY", t3.preset_id AS "presetId", t1.tenant_id AS "tenantId", t1.industry_code AS "industryCode" FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan t1 left join vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel t2 ON t1.id = t2.cruise_plan_id left join vm_ar_tags_info t3 ON t2.tag_id = t3.id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t3.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.id = #{id} AND t1.execution_status = 1 ORDER BY order_num

SELECT t1.ar_view_id AS "arViewId", t3.channel_code AS "channelCode", t3.id AS tagId, t2.stay_duration AS "stayDuration", t3.tags_type AS "tagsType", t3.tags_position AS "tagsPosition", t3.tags_name AS "tagsName", t3.tags_desc AS "tagsDesc", t3.coordinate, t3.resolutionx AS "resolutionX", t3.resolutiony AS "resolutionY", t3.preset_id AS "presetId", t3.tag_class FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan t1 left join vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel t2 ON t1.id = t2.cruise_plan_id left join vm_ar_tags_info t3 ON t2.tag_id = t3.id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t3.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.ar_view_id = #{arViewId} AND t1.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND t1.execution_status = 1
SELECT id, tag_id, tag_class, order_num FROM vm_ar_cruise_plan_rel WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND cruise_plan_id = #{cruisePlanId}
